messages.text: Hi! How can I help you today?
can you tell me latest news

The latest news covers a wide range of topics including U.S. and world events, weather, entertainment, politics, and health, with updates available from major outlets like CNN, Yahoo News, Fox News, and CBS News.
give me  news of un assembly

Recent news from the UN General Assembly includes reports of dozens of delegates walking out in protest during a speech by Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu, and Afghanistan losing its voting rights due to unpaid membership fees.
